description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Feign client related to document management within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup, creating, retrieving, updating, downloading, and deleting documents, utilizing JUnit 5 testing framework.

classes.name: FeignDocumentTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing document-related API operations via a Feign client in the Apache Fineract project.

methods.name: setupClient
methods.description: Sets up a client before executing other tests, storing the created client ID.

methods.name: testCreateDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document for a client, uploading a test image file.

methods.name: testRetrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves all documents associated with a client.

methods.name: testGetDocument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific document and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testDownloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a document's file content and verifies the size.

methods.name: testUpdateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document with new name and description, then verifies the update.

methods.name: testDeleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a document and verifies deletion by expecting a 404 exception on subsequent retrieval.

methods.name: testCreateDocumentBadArgs
methods.description: Attempts to create a document with bad arguments and expects an exception.
